title: Crew Notice on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Collection, by the Service That Delivered the Item
content:
The crew notice is fixed as follows. Where the service the item was delivered on offers no slot inside the freight crew lead days, the freight crew notice days are the notice. Where that service offers no slot inside the crew lead threshold days but does offer one inside the freight crew lead days, the two person crew notice days are the notice. Where that service offers a slot inside the crew lead threshold days, the schedule's collection lead days are the notice.

The freight crew lead days are 5. The crew lead threshold days are 3. The freight crew notice days are 8. The two person crew notice days are 6.

## What is read, and where from

The notice in question is the notice on which a Northbeam Returns and Restocking collection is agreed.

The service the item was delivered on is the fulfilment service recorded for that item on Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment, and the lead read is the shortest lead that service publishes. A service whose shortest lead is 5 days or more offers no slot inside the freight crew lead days. A service whose shortest lead is 3 days or more offers no slot inside the crew lead threshold days. A service whose shortest lead is fewer than 3 days offers one.

| Shortest lead of the delivering service | The crew notice |
| --- | --- |
| 5 days or more | 8 days |
| 3 or 4 days | 6 days |
| fewer than 3 days | the collection lead days published against the return schedule the line falls under |

## Both sides of each threshold, on hypothetical inputs

*A delivering service whose shortest lead is 5 days.* Five is 5 or more, so the crew notice is 8 days.

*A delivering service whose shortest lead is 4 days.* Four is fewer than 5 but 3 or more, so the crew notice is 6 days.

*A delivering service whose shortest lead is 3 days.* Three is 3 or more and fewer than 5, so the crew notice is 6 days.

*A delivering service whose shortest lead is 2 days.* Two is fewer than 3, so the crew notice is the collection lead days of the return schedule the line falls under.

*An item for which no delivering service lead is recorded at all.* Nothing read comes to 3 or more, so the crew notice is the collection lead days of the return schedule the line falls under.
